sweeps.angle: GitHub + GitHub-API + forum-archive sweep for downloadable BO3 Mod Tools weapon-port kits, anchored on the project's trusted ground-truth repo (FanaticSoftware/Skye-Weapon-Templates), resolving each of the 7 target weapons (B23R, Tac-19, AK-47, M14 EBR, G3, FN FAL, Intervention) to a concrete, verified download.
sweeps.general_findings: KEY STRUCTURAL FINDING: GitHub hosts almost NO actual BO3 weapon assets. GitHub API searches ('bo3 weapon port', 'bo3 weapons', '"black ops 3" weapons gdt', 'topic:bo3-mod-tools' — the topic returns total_count 0) surface only utilities, not asset kits. The BO3 weapon-port ecosystem distributes APE-ready kits via UGX-Mods/Modme forum threads with Mega/iCloud links; GitHub repos (like the trusted Skye-Weapon-Templates) are the WIRING layer (CSV weapon lists, zone lines, sound aliases, GSC) that pairs with those packs. The dominant — effectively canonical — source is TheSkyeLord's 'Skye's Weapon Ports to BO3 (Master Hub)' on UGX-Mods (791 weapons ported, thread live, last posts 2025; fetched via the SMF printpage endpoint after the normal URL 403'd). TARGET WEAPON RESOLUTION (all 7 covered by Skye): B23R = BO2 weapon, NOT MW3 (t6_b23r; individual port verified with wallbuy); Tac-19 = AW pack (s1_tac19, verified in AW template CSV + individual Mega link); AK-47 = available in 6 packs (iw4_/t5_/t6_/s1_/h1_ + CoD4 individual port with wallbuy); M14 EBR = MW2 pack (iw4_m14ebr + individual Mega link); G3 is NOT a WaW weapon — WaW has the Gewehr 43; the G3 exists as Skye's CoD4 port (verified individual iCloud link, includes wallbuy, PaP ACOG) and in the MWR pack (h1_g3, verified in MWR template CSV); FN FAL = BO1 pack (t5_fal) + BO2 pack (t6_fal semi-auto + t6_fal_osw with wallbuy, both individual Mega links verified); Intervention = MW2 pack (iw4_intervention + individual Mega link verified). NAMING CONVENTION (matters for this repo's CLAUDE.md weapon-name trap): Skye weapon names are engine-prefixed (iw4_=MW2, t5_=BO1, t6_=BO2, s1_=AW, h1_=MWR, t8_=BO4...), GDTs are skye_<prefix>_<gun> in source_data — these are CUSTOM weapons added via gamedata/weapons/zm/zm_levelcommon_weapons.csv stringtable, distinct from stock class-based names (ar_accurate etc.). Hub FAQ notes a ~150 weapons-per-map practical limit and that wallbuy price-0 bugs come from missing the zone stringtable line or CSV ordering. NEGATIVE RESULTS: treminaor/ugx-mod-bo3 contains NO weapon ports (only ugx_weapon_box xmodel_bin + HUD/gamemode assets); HarryBo21's WaW/BO2 gun-port pack (B23R, FN FAL, AK-47, M14 — no G3) has dead links per the Modme archive; EthanArmbrust/bo3-weapon-porter is a single weapon-reader.cpp GDT-conversion utility, no assets; no other GitHub repo with weapon GDT packs found. RECOMMENDED PATH FOR THIS PROJECT: on the Windows box, install the Skye per-game packs (or just the 7 individual weapon installers + their per-game Weapon Commons), copy the matching weapon lines from the Skye-Weapon-Templates per-game zm_levelcommon_weapons.csv + zone lines + share/raw sound aliases (skye_<game>_weapons.csv) into zm_abandoned_cyber_city, and set wallbuy structs' zombie_weapon_upgrade to the skye weapon names (e.g. iw4_intervention) — the templates repo gives known-good reference wiring for every line needed.

sweeps.general_findings: BOTTOM LINE: TheSkyeLord's Master Hub is the only source that covers every requested weapon in APE-ready form with links that work TODAY. I verified liveness programmatically via the Mega.nz public API (a 'g' file-info query per file handle; a size response = file exists, -9 = deleted, -16 = uploader account terminated) on 2026-06-12. Results: all 10 of Skye's older per-game full packs are ALIVE (BO2 569 MB, MW2 348 MB, BO1 444 MB, AW 2.14 GB, MWR 1.70 GB, MW3 401 MB, Ghosts 1.33 GB, IW 1.95 GB, WWII 2.11 GB, BO4 1.40 GB), all five relevant per-game 'Weapon Common Asset' downloads are ALIVE (mandatory companions — PaP camo + shared textures/sounds break without them), and the individual links for every target weapon are ALIVE except the BO2 B23R single-gun link (dead, but the B23R ships inside the live BO2 full pack). The MW2019 full pack is the only dead pack link; MW2019 guns remain available via the two individual-weapons page bundles. TARGET WEAPON MAP: B23R -> Skye BO2 pack; Tac-19 -> Skye AW pack (individual link alive, includes wallbuy); AK-47 -> Skye BO1, MW2, MWR, or AW packs (4 distinct versions, BO1/MWR with wallbuys); M14 EBR -> Skye MW2 pack (individual link alive); G3 -> Skye MWR pack (individual link alive, includes wallbuy); FN FAL -> Skye BO1 pack (wallbuy) or MW2 FAL or BO2 FAL/FAL OSW; Intervention -> Skye MW2 pack (individual link alive). Format is exactly what this repo needs: drag-and-drop BO3-root folders containing xmodel_bin, xanim_export, source_data .gdt (APE-ready, weapon stats editable under the skye_* GDTs), sound assets + alias CSVs, and Radiant wallbuy prefabs whose structs match the weapon_upgrade anatomy already documented in CLAUDE.md; integration is two zone-file line types (stringtable,gamedata/weapons/zm/zm_levelcommon_weapons.csv once, weapon,<name> per gun) plus CSV rows — note Skye's stated practical ceiling of ~150 custom weapons per map. The FanaticSoftware/Skye-Weapon-Templates GitHub repo (already a trusted source in this project's CLAUDE.md, updated May 2026) automates the wiring via Launcher 'rex' templates but does NOT bundle the assets. NEGATIVE RESULTS: HarryBo21's ports (the other historical source for B23R/FAL/M14/AK47) are intentionally withdrawn — every link dead, author requested no reuploads, zero GitHub mirrors; do not plan around them. ProRevenge's ports (explicit 'use as you please' license, GDTs included) are all dead via Mega account termination and didn't cover the target list anyway. CabConModding offerings are compiled .mods archives, wrong format for usermap source integration. DEVRAW is the live modern hub but skews to MW23/BO6-era content. CREDIT NORMS: no formal licenses anywhere in this scene; the enforced norm is a credits list in your map description naming the porter (TheSkyeLord) — HarryBo21's takedown is the cautionary tale for skipping credits. Best-practice DIY tutorial if a one-off port is ever needed: the Modme wiki Weapon-Porting guide (Greyhound/Wraith -> Maya+CoDMayaTools -> xmodel_bin -> APE GDT material/xmodel/xanim -> bulletweapon asset -> zone line); the 2016 Steam guide is outdated. CAVEATS: Mega API confirms file existence, not content integrity; the old-format #! links auto-redirect in modern browsers; one known packaging bug — Skye's BO2 B23R folder historically shipped the AK-47 wallbuy prefab by mistake, so fix that prefab path if using a B23R wallbuy.

sweeps.general_findings:
Headline: after checking all four named repos' full git trees plus UGX Mod, Skye's org, and clixmods, NO shipped-map GitHub repo commits custom-weapon GDT/xmodel_bin source. That is structural, not an accident: BO3 weapon assets (GDTs in source_data/, XMODEL_BIN in model_export/, xanims in xanim_export/, sound_assets) install at the BO3 ROOT, outside usermaps/, and the dominant packs (TheSkyeLord's) are redistributed only via his Master Hub downloads — so map repos commit only the usermap-relative integration surface. zm_alien_isolation, the one repo that commits root-level source_data/model_export, has no weapon entries in its GDTs and its weaponfull lines are commented out. Direct answer to the MattFiler question: it does NOT ship custom weapon GDTs.

The complete per-weapon file set a port needs (assembled from zm_countryside [shipped, MIT, compiled-proof via zone_source/all/assetinfo] + Skye templates + Master Hub doc):
(1) BO3 root, from the pack download (NOT in any repo): source_data/*.gdt (bulletweapon + xmodel + xanim + attachment entries, APE prefix skye_<game>), model_export/**/*.XMODEL_BIN, xanim_export/, sound_assets/, share/ (sound aliases also mirrored in Skye-Weapon-Templates at share/raw/sound/aliases/skye_*.csv).
(2) usermaps/<map>/zone_source/<map>.zone: one `weapon,<name>` line per variant — base, `_up`, dual-wield `_rdw_up_zm`/`_ldw_up_zm` — plus `stringtable,gamedata/weapons/zm/zm_levelcommon_weapons.csv`. Modern Skye-pack maps use `weapon,`; `weaponfull,` only when attachments must be force-loaded.
(3) usermaps/<map>/gamedata/weapons/zm/zm_levelcommon_weapons.csv: header `weapon_name,upgrade_name,hint,cost,weaponVO,weaponVOresp,ammo_cost,create_vox,is_zcleansed,in_box,upgrade_in_box,is_limited,limit,upgrade_limit,content_restrict,wallbuy_autospawn,class,is_aat_exempt,is_wonder_weapon,force_attachments`; example row `t9_gallo_sa12,t9_gallo_sa12_up,,1500,shotgun,,,,,TRUE,FALSE,FALSE,,,FALSE,TRUE,shotgun,,,` pairing with zone lines `weapon,t9_gallo_sa12` + `weapon,t9_gallo_sa12_up`.
(4) Optional: scripts/lilrobot/_inspectable_weapons.gsc (+ scriptparsetree line) for inspect anims; gamedata/weapons/common/attachmentmappingsTable.csv + weaponoptions.csv when a pack needs attachment overrides (zm_building shows this).
(5) Map geo: wallbuy struct's `zombie_weapon_upgrade` set to the pack's class weapon name (consistent with our existing weapon_upgrade anatomy in CLAUDE.md).

Implications for our repo: since assets live at BO3 root, tools/sync_to_modtools.ps1 needs no change for weapons; our repo only ever needs the .zone lines + gamedata CSV (and the Windows box needs the pack installed once). Dual-wield/upgrade naming is irregular per weapon (e.g. t9_marshal has no _up, only _rdw_up_zm/_ldw_up_zm), so always copy names from the template.zone for the chosen pack rather than deriving them. Confidence notes: every repo/file claim above was fetched live from api.github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com on 2026-06-12; zm_countryside tree confirmed not truncated and includes linker assetinfo output proving the weapon list actually compiled. GitHub code search (api needs auth) and grep.app (429 rate-limited) could not be used to exhaustively rule out an obscure repo shipping weapon GDTs, so the 'nobody ships GDTs' claim is high-confidence but not exhaustive.

sweeps.general_findings:
1) COMMUNITY NORMS (credit/permission). The norm, consistent across UGX and Modme: using released port packs in your own map is expected and encouraged, but (a) you must add the porter to your map's credit list (Rico's thread makes it a hard requirement with exact wording; Skye requests credit to 'TheSkyeLord' plus tool authors), (b) you must NOT re-host/re-release the packs themselves or modified versions without asking, and (c) anything not publicly released requires a direct permission ask (Harry Bo21's Origins pack is the cautionary example — he pulled public links and access is now ask-only). UGX site rules say not to use other people's work without permission and to give proper credit; the long-standing UGX 'Modder Ethics' thread (https://www.ugx-mods.com/forum/general-discussion/21/modder-ethics/7643 — UGX forum blocks automated fetch, content confirmed via search excerpts) frames it as respecting free labor: released-asset use with credit = fine, modifying/redistributing someone's work = permission required. Practical etiquette for our Workshop description: a Credits section listing each porter (e.g., 'Weapon ports: TheSkyeLord'), the tutorial/rig author (Azsry), and tool authors (DTZxPorter, Scobalula), and a quick courtesy DM on Modme/Discord for anything ambiguous. Releases that ship others' assets without credit get called out publicly and delisted from community sites.

2) ATVI TOLERANCE. No documented case found of Activision taking down a BO3 Workshop zombies map for containing weapons ported from other CoD titles — across 9+ years of the BO3 Workshop (opened 2016) and thousands of maps. Skye's 552-weapon hub has been openly hosted on Modme and UGX since ~2020 and cross-posted weapon mods remain live on the Workshop. Greyhound's README even names 'Black Ops III Mod Tools' as an intended destination. Treyarch shipped the mod tools knowing porting was the dominant use; community tutorials (including the official-adjacent Modme wiki) have never been targeted. The real enforcement precedents are all standalone clients/recreations, not Workshop usermaps: H2M (MW2-in-MWR client) C&D'd Aug 2024 one day before launch (https://kotaku.com/mw2-h2m-mod-activision-cease-and-desist-killed-steam-pc-1851623649), and SM2 (MW2019-engine remake) before that. Risk profile: porting CoD-to-CoD inside ATVI's own sandbox = tolerated grey zone; porting non-ATVI IP (Apex, Nintendo franchises) raises third-party-rights risk and is where the rare Workshop removals (generic Steam guideline violations) cluster. Conclusion: shipping community CoD weapon ports in our Workshop map is normal practice with effectively zero takedown precedent; keep non-CoD IP out.

3) TOOL PIPELINE STATUS (June 2026). Extraction: Greyhound v1.46.3.2 downloadable from GitHub releases (Apr 2024; newer via Discord; dest1yo maintains Greyhound + Cordycep). Wraith Archon is dead as a download — dtzxporter/WraithX archived Nov 2021 with zero GitHub releases, and aviacreations.com (which hosted Wraith + ExportX) is unreachable (connection refused); treat Greyhound as the only extractor. Maya path: CoDMayaTools v2.9 (github.com/Ray1235/CoDMayaTools — repo archived Dec 2022 but the 2018 release binary is still downloadable; Maya 2012+) plus dtzxporter's SETools for seanim/semodel import. Blender path (more future-proof): maintained blender-cod forks — pv_blender_cod (https://github.com/prov3ntus/pv_blender_cod, Blender 3.x-4.x) and BlenderCODTool (https://github.com/Valerie-Bosco/BlenderCODTool, 4.1+) export XMODEL_EXPORT/XMODEL_BIN directly; original CoDEmanX/blender-cod still exists but is stale. Bin conversion: Kronos download links are dead; use export2bin (ships inside BO3 Mod Tools — always available) or MakeCents' Export2Bin Drag&Drop (https://sites.google.com/site/makecentsgaming/home/makecents-mod-tools-bo3); ExportX is unverifiable (host down). APE + linker + Launcher ship with the Steam mod tools. Net: the DIY pipeline is fully assemblable in 2026, but two of the four classic tools (Wraith, Kronos) are dead and have drop-in replacements.

4) EFFORT ESTIMATE. The Modme Weapon-Porting wiki itself states first-timers take 'up to 4 hours to complete a single weapon port' — that excludes one-time tool setup (Greyhound + Maya/Blender + plugins + rig: budget another 2-4 hours) and assumes nothing goes wrong with the animation conversion rig (cross-game bone renames/namespace removal are the documented pain point; snipers and multi-part models add more). Realistic first weapon end-to-end: a full day (6-8h); weapons 2-5: 1-3h each; sound aliasing and APE material setup are the recurring sinks. By contrast, the pre-made route (Skye/Rico packs) is ~15-30 minutes per weapon — extract to BO3 root, CSV row, zone lines, wallbuy struct — with zero Maya/Greyhound involvement. RECOMMENDATION for this project: since our Windows compile day is already the bottleneck and our template is literally Skye's (FanaticSoftware/Skye-Weapon-Templates), use Skye's APE-ready packs for any non-stock weapons, put porter credits in the Workshop description, and reserve DIY porting (4h/weapon) for any one-off weapon the packs lack.
